title: Extension registry record
description: What an author writes in extensions/<id>.json. Everything else (name, type, engines, sandbox, ...) is read from manifest.json inside the archive, so it cannot disagree with the extension.

id.description: Same as manifest.json id, for example acme.redis-driver. The file is named <id>.json.

downloadUrl.description: A release asset on GitHub. Nothing else is accepted.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the archive, lowercase hex.

yanked.description: Hides the extension from the Marketplace without deleting the record.

testEnv.description: The database the CI tests a database driver against.

connect.description: Extra db.connect parameters; host and port are filled in.
